annotations.title: Remove one item from a Caliper dataset

description: Drops one item. Ratings and run results keyed to it are orphaned (kept in history, gone from the dataset). A dataset must keep at least one item. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: caliper_datasets_remove_item
title: Remove one item from a Caliper dataset
